testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel closing the application when a document has unsaved changes: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/application-closing/application-closing.feature:4:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel closing the application when a document has unsaved changes ✔ Given the MCAD Software has an open part document with unsaved changes ✔ When the user selects the application window's Close control ✔ Then a save-changes prompt identifies the part document ✔ And the prompt offers Yes, No and Cancel ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the save-changes prompt closes ✔ And the part document remains open ✔ And the MCAD Software remains open
